preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership) to call mint() function
Attacker must have some initial token balance to call burn() function

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the burn() and mint() functions which incorrectly use reflection values instead of token amounts. As owner, call mint() with a large amount to massively increase token supply and attacker balance. Then call burn() with a small reflection value to burn minimal tokens while appearing to burn a large amount. This allows unlimited token minting and incorrect burn accounting.
